title: Coherence-assisted quantum state preparation and thermal control through repeated interactions
abstract: We investigate the relaxation dynamics and steady state of a qubit interacting with a coherent environment through an energy-conserving flip-flop interaction within the Markovian repeated-interaction framework. We derive an exact analytical solution for the evolving and stationary state, nonperturbative in the environmental coherence. We show that environmental coherence provides a resource for dissipative state preparation by expanding the set of accessible steady states. In particular, coherent ancillas can increase the system ground- state population beyond that of the bath, corresponding to an effective temperature below the bath temperature, and enhance its steady-state purity, with these effects controlled by the interplay between the system energy scale and the system-ancilla coupling. Nevertheless, we prove that the purity of the system can never exceed the purity of the ancilla. We further analyze the thermodynamics of the protocol and show that environmental coherence can modify and even reverse the natural direction of heat transfer, giving rise to anomalous heat flow. Remarkably, for fixed interaction parameters, the direction of the coherence-induced heat transfer is governed by the relative phase between the system and ancilla coherence, whereas their magnitudes determine the amount of heat exchanged. Our results establish environmental coherence as a resource for controlling steady-state preparation and energy transfer in repeated-interaction dynamics.
summary: This theoretical paper analyzes a qubit interacting with a coherent environment through repeated collisions. It demonstrates that environmental coherence acts as a powerful resource, allowing the system to achieve steady states with enhanced purity and even cool below the bath temperature. Furthermore, it shows that this coherence can induce anomalous heat flow, controlled by the relative phase between system and ancilla coherence.
main_problem: The paper investigates how environmental coherence influences the relaxation dynamics and steady state of a qubit interacting with a coherent environment via repeated interactions.
main_result: Environmental coherence acts as a quantum resource, enabling cooling below the bath temperature and allowing for anomalous heat flow whose direction depends on the relative phase of the coherence.

model_or_system: The model consists of a single qubit (System, S) interacting sequentially with an ancillary qubit (Ancilla, A) via a flip-flop interaction Hamiltonian. The dynamics are treated as a Markovian process.
key_observables: System ground-state population ($p^{(n)}_S$), coherence ($c^{(n)}_S$), steady-state purity, and the direction/amount of heat transfer.
important_parameters: System-ancilla coupling strength ($J$), interaction time ($	au$), environmental coherence magnitude ($|c_A|$), and the relative phase between system and ancilla coherence.
main_assumptions: The analysis assumes the system and ancilla are resonant ($\omega_S = \omega_A$) and that the process is Markovian (no memory effects between collisions).
figures_summary: The notes mention figures illustrating the required number of iterations ($n^*$) to reach steady state, showing it increases with environmental coherence, and plots showing the steady-state coherence and $l_1$-norm as a function of environmental coherence.
paper_structure: The paper introduces the model and derives the exact solution (Section II), investigates cooling below bath temperature and purity enhancement (Section III), and analyzes the thermodynamics and anomalous heat flow (Section IV).
why_interesting: This work directly addresses non-equilibrium thermodynamics and open quantum systems, showing how environmental correlations (coherence) can violate simple thermal assumptions to control energy flow and state preparation.

figures.caption: FIG. 1: Diagram of the dynamics induced by sequential interactions with thermal ancillas at temperature 1/β. At each step n, the system evolves from state ρ(n) S to state ρ(n+1) S through an interaction with an ancilla in the Gibbs state ρA. Due to the interaction, the ancilla evolves into an “exhausted” state ρex A . The ancilla is replaced or refreshed before the next interaction. The system evolves towards the thermal state of temperature 1/β.

FIG. 2: Diagram of system dynamics induced by sequential interactions with coherent ancillas. At each step n, the system evolves from state ρ(n) S to ρ(n+1) S through an interaction with a coherent ancilla in the initial state ρA. The ancilla evolves into an “exhausted” state ρex A . It is replaced or refreshed before the next interaction. The system evolves towards its fixed point, a state with nonzero coherence.
